senses.gloss:
छाया छाया, f. (said to be fr. rt. छो, to
cut off the light; perhaps a corruption of छद्या fr.
rt. 1. छद्), shade, shadow, dark shadow, a shady
place, (in the Naighaṇṭuka III. 4. = a screened or
covered place, i. e. a house); a reflected image, re-
flection; a shadowy fancy, hallucination; shading or
blending of colours, play of light or colours, lustre,
light, beauty; colour, the colour of the face, com-
plexion, the features; a kind of metre consisting of
four lines of nineteen syllables each; Shadow personi-
fied, and like Sañjñā wife of the Sun and mother of the
planet Saturn; the sun; the shadow of a gnomon as
indicating the sun's position; a screen, protection,
nourishing, cherishing; a row, line, straight or con-
tinuous line; nightmare; a bribe; a N. of the goddess
Durgā; (अम्), n. shade, shadow (at the end of a
Tat-puruṣa compound); (अस्), m. one who grants
shade.
—छाया-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing shadow,
shadowing, shading; (अस्), m. a parasol or umbrella-
bearer; a species of metre.
—छाया-ग्रह, अस्, m.
‘receiving the shadow or image,’ a mirror, a sun-
dial (?); [cf. छाया-यन्त्र.]
—छायाङ्क (˚या-
अङ्˚), अस्, m. the moon (containing the image of a
hare or deer, i. e. marked like a hare or deer); [cf.
छाया-भृत् and छाया-मृग-धर.]
—छाया-
तनय, अस्, m. the son of Chāyā, an epithet of
Saturn.
—छाया-तरु, उस्, m. a large umbrageous tree,
(giving abundant shade or shelter.)
—छायात्मज
(˚या-आत्˚), अस्, m. the son of Chāyā, an epithet of
Saturn.
—छायात्मन् (˚या-आत्˚), आ, m. a reflected
image or form (lit. ‘shadow-self,’ the shadow or re-
flected image of one's own person).
—छाया-द्रुम,
अस्, m. an umbrageous tree; see छाया-तरु.
—छाया-
द्वितीय, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by one's shadow.
[]
—छाया-पथ, अस्, m. ether, the atmosphere or
firmament.
—छाया-पुरुष, अस्, m. Puruṣa in
the form of a shadow.
—छाया-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्,
divided in radiance, reflecting light from various
surfaces.
—छाया-भृत्, त्, m. the moon; [cf.
छायाङ्क.]
—छाया-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, shadowy,
casting a shadow, reflected.
—छाया-मान, अम्, n.
an instrument that measures a shadow.
—छाया-
मित्र, अम्, n. a chattar or parasol (friend of the
shade).
—छाया-मृग-धर, अस्, m. ‘possessing
the image of a deer,’ the moon; [cf. छायाङ्क.]
—छाया-यन्त्र, अम्, n. ‘shadow instrument,’ a sun-
dial.
—छाया-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, shadowy, possessing
or granting shade.
—छाया-व्यवहार, अस्, m.
measuring or calculating the shadow cast by the sun
on the dial.
—छाया-सुत, अस्, m. the son of Chāyā,
an epithet of Saturn.
छायक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. shadowy (as a demon).
